headline: Flameruff Branch
title: Flameruff Evolution | Scorchhowl or Inferlupa | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Flameruff comes from Emberpup at level twelve. At level twenty it splits into two paths. Scorchhowl needs you to defeat the Alpha Scorchhowl and a Blaze Stone. Inferlupa needs you to complete Journey Warrior, a Night Stone and six Unbroken Flameruff Spirits. Each Flameruff takes only one exit, so choose carefully. Scorchhowl is Fire, Inferlupa is Dark and Fire. Which will you pick? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Flameruff evolves at level 20 into Scorchhowl (defeat the Alpha, Blaze Stone) or Inferlupa (Journey: Warrior, Night Stone, six Unbroken Flameruff Spirits). Only one path per Flameruff.
